records.part: RDS (Radio Dispatch System) hardware and software
records.reason: The current RDS hardware and software are obsolete and no longer supported by the manufacturer.
AT&T T1 analog leased lines are obsolete, and AT&T will no longer support them.

records.part: Digital VoIP phones utilizing JPB fiber network to replace obsolete RDS
records.reason: The scope is to perform a technology refresh of the obsolete RDS (Radio Dispatch System) with digital components to utilize the JPB fiber network and the digital VoIP phones.
